svg.text: SpecLab / choose lookahead, including no speculation
Oracle finite tables. Exact Bellman values and path laws, not a measured latency predictor.
1 A full-strength fixed baseline, not a weak fixed gamma
Target: root A/B equally likely, then repeat that first token. Draft: root A/B, then always A.
Four output tokens; assigned price = verification rounds + draft calls / 10.
Exact target law: AAAA with 1/2, BBBB with 1/2. Every policy preserves this law.
Unreachable prefixes are solved too, but never charged to the executed policy.
Root action values with optimal future
Action 3 at root; action 0 after BB.
Now charge each target position 1 and each draft call 1/10; verification rounds are free.
The optimal action is 0 at every prefix, with assigned cost
No speculation is a genuine action: one target token, one round, zero draft calls.
Boundary contract: g = min(action, remaining - 1); final slot has canonical action 0.
Ties choose the smallest action. All choices and nonnegative Bellman slacks are retained.
Known target/draft tables are an oracle input. Planning and policy lookup overhead are not modeled.
This chooses a length before drafting, not a learned confidence/entropy threshold during drafting.
No EOS, predictor training, transformer/GPU execution, throughput or novel algorithm claim.
Complete Bellman transitions, model inputs, policy and joint sequence/count laws remain in metadata.
